description_en: Queries outbound call records for an industry edition AI batch task
description_zh: 行业版AI批量任务查询外呼记录
name: TaskCallList

parameters.help_en: The intent tag for exact matching. For example, specify "C" to query records with intent tag C. To query multiple intents, specify ["A","B","C"]
parameters.help_zh:
如“C”，则精准查询意向标签为C的数据；
若查询多个意向则["A","B","C”]；
parameters.name: intent_tags

parameters.help_en: The batch ID returned when numbers are imported
parameters.help_zh: 导入号码时返回的批次号
parameters.name: batch_id

parameters.help_en: The numbers for exact matching. Batch query is supported with a maximum of 1000 numbers
parameters.help_zh: 需要精确查询的号码，,支持批量 最大1000个号码
parameters.name: numbers

parameters.help_en: The start date of outbound calls. Only dates within the last 30 days can be queried. Format: 2020-03-06 10:10:10
parameters.help_zh: 开始外呼日期，只可查询最近30天的日期，格式:2020-03-06 10:10:10
parameters.name: call_date

parameters.help_en: The end time of outbound calls. Only one day of data can be queried. The start and end dates must be different time points on the same day. Format: 2020-03-06 10:10:10
parameters.help_zh: 结束外呼时间，只可查一天的数据，开始外呼日期和结束外呼日期是同一天的不同时间点。 格式支持 2020-03-06 10:10:10
parameters.name: end_call_date

parameters.help_en: The number of outbound call records per page. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 10000
parameters.help_zh: 每页外呼记录数,正整数，默认10000
parameters.name: page_size
